title: Dashboard: Enter opens tick detail view
description:
Human decision (2026-08-12): the board cursor (j/k + Selected()) finally gets its one job — Enter on the selected tick opens a read-only DETAIL VIEW; esc (or Enter again) returns to the board.

Detail content, from the same read-only sources the snapshot already uses (tick store + manifests + live herd state — NEVER a tk subprocess): title/id/status/priority, full description (wrapped, scrollable if long), acceptance criteria, blockers/blocked-by, worker info when a manifest exists (kind, model, pane, workspace, branch, worktree path, age/status timers reusing the qh6 helpers), and recent activity/notes if cheaply readable from the store (check what internal/ticks exposes; skip gracefully if not — do not shell out).

Implementation: internal/herd/dashboard only. A view-mode enum on the model (board | detail) with the detail rendering in view.go; events/reloads keep flowing while in detail (the underlying snapshot updates; detail re-renders from the refreshed snapshot — a closed tick shows its new status live). Keys: enter opens on Selected(); esc/enter closes; j/k scroll the detail when it overflows; q still quits from either mode. Update the pane/help footer line to advertise enter.

Read internal/herd/dashboard/doc.go + model/view/watch and the qh6 timer helpers first. Model tests: enter/esc mode transitions; detail renders the selected tick fields; snapshot refresh while in detail updates content; overflow scrolling bounds; q quits from detail. Boundaries: internal/herd/dashboard (+ cobra Long help text line in cmd/tk/cmd/herd_dashboard.go if it lists keys). Full-suite gate on real exits; gofmt/vet clean; do NOT commit your RESULT file.
